# IO.REG.ENV.IMPORT fixtures

Project-made test data, CC-BY-4.0. Generated by `make_fixtures.py` (Python standard library
only, independent of the Rust code); `python fixtures/io/reg/env/import/make_fixtures.py --check`
fails if a committed file is stale.

- `files/`: source files of the test formats `fid-test-points` (`.ftp`) and `fid-test-mesh`
  (`.ftm`): `ok.ftp` (one point set, AC-1), `many.ftp` (1,000 sets, AC-6 and the kit),
  `trunc.ftp` (1,000 sets, then a truncated one, AC-2), `names.ftp` (untrusted names: an
  injected instruction kept verbatim, a control and a bidi character dropped), `unitless.ftp`,
  `mesh.ftm` and `mesh-as.ftp` (mesh content under the points extension).
- `expected.json`: the project IDs, and per case the source digest, entity IDs, events,
  payloads, report (and dry-run report), report digest, state and per-stage digests.

See the generator's docstring for the test format and the pinned forms.
